description: Create three new files in a package: an interface and two implementations
prompt: In the shop package create an interface Discount with a method int apply(int cents), and two classes implementing it: PremiumDiscount (returns 85 percent of cents) and LargeOrderDiscount (returns 95 percent). Do not change the existing classes.

checks.command: javac -d out src/shop/*.java && java -cp out shop.Main
